sql.query: SELECT u.id userId,u.avatarPath FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles roleMembership INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=roleMembership.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE roleMembership.userId=:currentUser AND roleMembership.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND roleMembership.isActive=1)
